status: Snowbound Peaks recording-ready. Deep Ice Caves and Ellis rescue follow in the next batch.

heath.name: Heath
heath.role: Mountain guide keeping a shelter open while Ellis is missing

ff.heath.first.text: If you've come for the view, you're early. The clouds usually move next week. You're looking for Ellis? He scratched those arrows himself. Said nobody would follow a scientist into a freezing mountain. Then the Legion came asking.

choices.text: I came to find him. What do I need?

effects.title: Shelter before the storm
effects.text: Heath needs the heater part from the abandoned lift house west of his shelter. Bring it back to him. The sheltered ridge avoids the exposed crossing.

choices.text: Skip the weather report. Where is he?

voice.speaker: heath
voice.scene: A shelter above the snow line
voice.emotion: Dry, practical warmth; a tired male mountain guide.
voice.direction: Dry, practical warmth; a tired male mountain guide.
voice.context: Snowbound Peaks. The player seeks Professor Ellis after freeing the prisoners at Ruined Keep. Heath knows his mountain trail, not what has happened inside the caves. No Bladeborn reveal. A shelter above the snow line

ff.heath.blunt.text: Up. That's the short answer. The useful answer takes a little longer, and I'd rather not carry you back down in pieces.

choices.text: Fair enough. Tell me the useful answer.

ff.heath.prepare.text: Ellis used the caves above the signal crown. The entrance disappears under fresh snow. First, help me get this shelter working. There's a heater part in the old lift house. Bring it here and I'll thaw the crossing winch. The longer ridge is sheltered if the wind gets rough.

choices.text: Why was Ellis hiding up here?
How do I cross in this wind?

ff.heath.ellis.text: He came up with a pack full of papers and barely enough food for a day. Kept asking whether anyone had followed him. I didn't ask what he'd done. I asked whether he wanted soup. He said yes before I finished the question.

ff.heath.wind.text: Watch the hanging cloth near the lift house. First it stirs, then it snaps sideways. Wait behind the rock until it hangs loose again. Or take the tucked-away ridge. Being brave doesn't mean arguing with the weather.

ff.heath.camp.text: An explorer used to camp west of the upper trail. Carved notches into three stones so he could find his box after a storm. Said the shadows would remember the order. I told him a pocket would be simpler.

effects.title: The buried camp
effects.text: Heath mentioned an explorer’s camp west of the upper trail. Three marked stones and their shadows may reveal the order of its lock.

ff.heath.repaired.text: There. Warm hands, a working winch, and one less thing trying to kill us. The crossing is down. That small healing pad still has some charge, but it won't last forever. Up at the signal crown, read the carving before you turn the reflectors. Ellis liked to hide a door in plain sight.

effects.title: Find the cave mouth
effects.text: The repaired crossing leads to the signal crown. Read the carving and match its shape using the reflectors. Then follow the light to the buried entrance.

choices.text: You should come down when this is over.

voice.speaker: heath
voice.scene: A shelter above the snow line
voice.emotion: Relief and quiet gratitude. The heater has just started.

ff.heath.home.text: Someone has to keep a light up here for people coming back. Find Ellis. I'll put another bowl on. And before you ask, yes, it is the same soup.

ff.heath.aftercamp.text: West of the upper trail. Three notched stones, with their shadows cut into the ground so snow couldn't erase the clue. He trusted stone more than his own memory. I can respect that.

effects.title: A trail in the snow
effects.text: Ellis scratched arrows toward Heath’s shelter above the switchbacks. The Legion is searching this mountain too.

effects.title: The heater part
effects.text: A heavy metal part survived inside the abandoned lift house. Heath may be able to use it.

effects.title: The signal carving
effects.text: “The tree drinks the light. The mountain turns it away. The broken moon shows the hollow.” Choose the matching shape on the signal stand.

effects.title: Something under the snow
effects.text: The notebook says: “Read the shadows from left to right. Then turn their stones in that order.” The carved shadows survive even under cloudy skies.

effects.title: The explorer’s keepsakes
effects.text: The buried chest held a winter cloak and a Rift Shard. Collect the shard beside the chest yourself. Reach Deep Ice Caves to keep both discoveries.
